Question 5

A part of the graph of a polynomial p(x) is given above. Which of the following statements is true?

a
x=9 is a multiple root of odd multiplicity
b
x=9 is not a root of p(x)
c
x=9 is a simple root of even multiplicity
d
x=9 is a multiple root of even multiplicity
e
x=9 is a simple root
